text:
sara: quick sync — onboarding `fuzzy-30b` today. weights are in s3://redwood-weights/fuzzy-30b/v1/ (models.tar.gz + checksums). can someone confirm the canonical path?

mike: confirmed that path. I pulled the manifest and started a weights-verify job. saw one mismatch on shard-03, re-uploading now. will ping when finished. :thumbsup:

anil: mhm, heads-up: tokenizer from the vendor has `special_tokens` ordering differing from our default. hitting occasional <unk> jumps in evals. can we pin `tokenizer.json` from the repo instead of their release?

sara: yes — prefer repo pin. devex, do we have a pinned tokenizer artifact?

devex: @sara we do. use `gs://redwood-artifacts/tokenizers/fuzzy-30b/2026-02-18/tokenizer.json` — it's the one with our space normalization patches.

eva: related: when running on MQA path, KV cache offsets look off if RoPE scale not applied. saw repeating context when scale_factor < 1.0. attaching quick log:
```
[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] request id=xyz token_pos=1024 kv_index=1023 repeat_detected=true
[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] model=fuzzy-30b variant=mqa rope_scale=0.875
```

mike: hmm — that matches a recent change in attention impl that defaults to legacy RoPE scaling for non-gqa variants. maybe the runtime-bot fallthrough routed this -> mqa without scale override. runtime-bot, what routing happened?

runtime-bot: routing decision: pool=dedicated-east, requested_variant=mqa, fallback_variant=gqa when capacity low: false. applied_policy=prefer_low_latency. scale_override not set.

anil: easy fix: on config we should set `rope_scale: auto` -> runtime computes based on positional base. but for fuzzy-30b we historically used `rope_scale: 1.0` in gqa mode. propose adding explicit override in serve-config.

sara: share the serve-config snippet (small) so infra can land it quickly.

mike: snippet below (will open PR):
```yaml
model: fuzzy-30b
variant: mqa
weights_path: s3://redwood-weights/fuzzy-30b/v1/models.tar.gz
tokenizer: gs://redwood-artifacts/tokenizers/fuzzy-30b/2026-02-18/tokenizer.json
serve_options:
  rope_scale: 1.0  # explicit to avoid legacy fallthrough
  kv_prefetch: true
  sliding_window: 2048
```

infra-bot: noticed config lint warning in CI: `serve_options.sliding_window` exceeds shard max (4096) -> ok. no blocking lint.

eva: also please add `tokenizer_normalize_spaces: true` in config. that reduces the <unk> spikes we saw on Chinese test set.

mike: will add both changes in PR #1287: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serve-configs/pull/1287 — pinging @anil and @devex for quick review.

anil: quick CR done, left one nudge about comment on why rope_scale=1.0 for mqa.

devex: tagging docs note — we should add an onboarding section describing `rope_scale` matrix for GQA vs MQA vs legacy models. filing doc ticket DOCS-401.

sara: thanks. plan: finish weight reupload -> infra lands serve-config PR -> smoke canary (1 host) -> run short eval set (20 prompts) to verify no repeats and tokenizer ok. target timeline: today EOD.

mike: weight reupload finished, checksums match now. kicked a canary deploy. :rocket:

eva: canary logs look clean for 10/20 prompts. tokenizer spacing fixed. one repeat on long prompt (token_pos ~ 3900) — that's expected with sliding_window wrap; we'll tune if it shows up in full eval.

sara: awesome. @everyone if you see anything odd in the canary channel, shout here. otherwise I'll mark onboard as "canary-passed" and schedule rollout tomorrow morning. :white_check_mark:

runtime-bot: canary deployment completed on host rded-84. health=ok, avg_latency=134ms, error_rate=0.2%

mike: PR merged. rolling to 10% -> 50% per rollout policy.

sara: excellent — thanks all.

devex: leaving a short note in the onboarding checklist: `tokenizer artifact pinned`, `rope_scale explicit`, `sliding_window in config`, `kv_prefetch enabled`.

anil: closing loop: I'll monitor for RoPE drift over next 24h and post any regressions here. :eyes:
